cues: Unlike JavaScript, PHP has full classes.
A class declares properties and methods; the constructor sets them up.
Inside the class, this arrow refers to the object's own members.
new creates an object, and the arrow, not a dot, reaches its members.
text: Unlike JavaScript, PHP has full classes. A class declares properties and methods; the constructor sets them up. Inside the class, this arrow refers to the object's own members. new creates an object, and the arrow, not a dot, reaches its members. extends gives inheritance.
